criterion: A closed convex image is protected when every recession direction killed by the map is reversible lineality; the common sufficient case is rec(C) intersect ker(A) = {0}.

examples.label: bounded-fiber model
examples.set: closed C with rec(C) intersect ker(A) = {0}

examples.label: sum of two closed sets
examples.set: C1 + C2 through the addition map
examples.danger_condition: z1 in rec(C1), z2 in rec(C2), z1 + z2 = 0 outside lineality
examples.criterion_passes: exactly when the danger condition is absent
